mapper.sql: m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.perms, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.del_flag, m.version, m.remark
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT
FROM sys_menu m
INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id
WHERE m.del_flag = 0
AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m
INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id
WHERE m.del_flag = 0 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
AND ur.user_id = #{userId}
